title: claude-code-router proxy routes Claude Code to DeepSeek and other backends
summary: The tutorial demonstrates a local Anthropic-compatible proxy that routes Claude Code traffic to providers including DeepSeek, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, LM Studio and Ollama. It enables a hybrid workflow in which DeepSeek V4 handles scaffolding and basic tasks while Claude Opus 4.7 handles complex UI and high-stakes code.

research.description: Use Claude Code as the foundation for coding infrastructure, allowing you to decide how to interact with the model while enjoying updates from Anthropic.
